QA-29129 is a PASS: all four assertions held on UCLA, LinkedIn only, Impressions data set, Last 30 Days (Sep 27 – Oct 26), 129 posts. The one caveat is the reach assertion (A5), which is only trivially satisfied.

- **A4 (Organic + Paid Impressions = Impressions):** holds on 129/129 posts. Paid Impressions is "–" on every post, so Organic equals Impressions.
- **A5 (Organic + Paid Reach = Reach):** Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach are "–" on every LinkedIn post, so there is no numeric data to check. Earlier runs of this case gave the same result.
- **A6a (Engagements / Impressions = Engagement Rate):** holds on 129/129 posts. The Average row's 1.02% matches 15,590 / 1,535,468.
- **A6b (Engaged User Rate shows an en dash):** "–" on 129/129 posts.

The case says only "Add a Brand", so I used the UCLA account's default brand, University of California, Los Angeles. There were no linked bugs and nothing was mutated, so no cleanup was needed.
